citation: 429 over the sliding-window limit — RFC 6585 §4 (429 Too Many Requests; response MAY include Retry-After) and RFC 9110 §10.2.3 (Retry-After delta-seconds); module 06 §4.5/§5.1 documented 600 requests/minute; { error, message } shape (§5.1). Router pairs this body with a Retry-After header.
notes: Rate limiting: <limit> is the configured window limit (default 600/min).
